summary: Iteration 20 — full independent verification of (1) Console per-user theme switcher, (2) Overview layout refinements (masked balance, range toggle, quick links, quick actions, collapsible activity), (3) Player splash hype-audio regression. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed for PUT /api/auth/console-theme + persistence via /me and login. Frontend: full Playwright flow across SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, ZONAL_MANAGER, MANAGER, and PLAYER — every assertion passed with zero runtime/page errors and zero console errors. Themes reset to default on cleanup for superadmin and admin1.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor UX observation (not a bug): the OverviewPanel range toggle (week/all) resets the masked-balance reveal state to hidden. Acceptable per spec (dots by default) but if intent was to preserve reveal across range switches, keep the 'revealed' boolean external to the metric-derived state.
auth.py console-theme endpoint silently coerces invalid themes to 'default' with 200 OK — consider returning 400 for clearer client contract; not blocking.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded accounts. Reset superadmin & admin1 console_theme to 'default' at end of tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file test_console_theme.py can be reused for regression. Frontend selectors verified: theme-switcher-btn, theme-option-{default,dark,sky,navy}, console-page[data-theme], overview-hero-value, balance-reveal-toggle, overview-range-{week,all}, ql-{managers,security,fantasy,zonal,admins,requests,apikeys}, qa-{deposits,settlements,transactions,report}, activity-toggle, activity-body, nav-{overview,branding,security}. Theme persistence survives full logout+login and hard reload. Themes are per-account (independent between superadmin & admin1).
